title: Rust ACK high-water advances for unrelated authenticated payload
description: FragmentSender.handle_ack_frame calls handle_ack_bytes, but even when wrong rule/status returns SenderOutput::None it still sets ack_high_counter. Passing a higher-counter authenticated non-ACK or wrong-rule frame to this public API suppresses a later legitimate lower-counter ACK. Advance the session control high-water only after a structurally valid, session-bound ACK/abort is consumed; test wrong rule/type/window/status and out-of-order legitimate controls.
